_note: Gemini tool declarations for google.generativeai SDK. Gemini CLI: add geminiCliMcp block to ~/.gemini/config.json.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_plan_task
functionDeclarations.description: Ask Cortex to break down a complex task into an execution plan of specialized agents.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_run_task_chain
functionDeclarations.description: Run the entire dynamic Octopus agent chain (Cortex planning + all needed agents + gate verification + session compact).

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_search_memory
functionDeclarations.description: Query the L1 structural graph memory to find relevant indexed files and their architectural context.

query.description: Search term (e.g. file name or symbol)

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_get_decisions
functionDeclarations.description: Retrieve past architectural decisions and risk flags from L2 memory.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_compact_session
functionDeclarations.description: Compress current workspace context into long-term memory at the end of an LLM session.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_execute_command
functionDeclarations.description: Execute arbitrary OS commands in the workspace (e.g., npm run test).

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_write_file
functionDeclarations.description: Write raw content to a file in the workspace.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_read_file
functionDeclarations.description: Read the contents of a file in the workspace.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_create_agent
functionDeclarations.description: Dynamically create and hot-reload a new Octopus agent into the active registry.

agentName.description: Name of the new agent in camelCase (e.g. frontendDeveloper)

javascriptLogic.description: Full Node.js module source for the agent

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_scan_security
functionDeclarations.description: Scan an array of file paths for cyberthreats and vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_llm_complete
functionDeclarations.description: Send a prompt to the active LLM provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or Ollama) and return the completion.

prompt.description: Prompt to send to the LLM

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_browser_navigate
functionDeclarations.description: Open a URL in the agent-browser and return a page snapshot with element refs.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_browser_snapshot
functionDeclarations.description: Capture accessibility tree snapshot from the active browser session. Returns element refs (@e1, @e2 …).

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_skill_scout
functionDeclarations.description: Trigger MarketScout to scan GitHub, npm, and PyPI for skill opportunities and deprecations.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_skill_synthesize
functionDeclarations.description: Toolsmith reads a documentation URL and synthesizes a new MCP skill (code + schema). Deploys to sandbox for QA.

doc_url.description: URL of the API or library documentation to read

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_skill_validate
functionDeclarations.description: Run SandboxQA on a synthesized skill. Self-corrects via Toolsmith on failure (up to 3 attempts).

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_skill_deploy
functionDeclarations.description: CEO deploys a sandbox-validated skill to the active registry. Retires any skill it supersedes.

skill_id.description: Skill ID to deploy (must have passed QA)

retires.description: Optional skill_id to retire when this one activates

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_skill_retire
functionDeclarations.description: Retire an active skill from the marketplace registry.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_skill_list
functionDeclarations.description: List all skills in the marketplace registry with their status and QA results.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_browser_interact
functionDeclarations.description: Interact with the active browser page: click, fill, type, or eval JavaScript.

ref.description: Element ref from snapshot (e.g. @e3) or CSS selector

value.description: Text to fill/type, or JS expression to evaluate

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_login
functionDeclarations.description: Zero-Key authentication: opens an interactive terminal menu (enquirer) to authorize a provider. Three paths: Anthropic API key, OpenAI API key, Google API key, or Vertex AI/Bedrock setup instructions. Keys are stored in the OS Vault (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service) — no .env editing required.

provider.description: Provider to authorize: anthropic | openai | google | enterprise (Vertex AI/Bedrock)

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_vault_check
functionDeclarations.description: Diagnostic: check which LLM providers have keys stored in the OS Vault or session file, and whether local Ollama is running. Reports the active provider and whether Sovereign Fallback is engaged.

functionDeclarations.name: octopus_memory_status
functionDeclarations.description: Diagnostic: ping the Python memory service (port 5000) and return its health status. Use this to verify the service is running before running agent task chains.
